Role: Android Developer 
 Location: Seattle, WA 
 Duration: 6+ Months 
 
 Job Description: 
 Senior Developers with At least five years of relevant mobile applications experience and a BS/MS in computer science or engineering (or equivalent professional experience). 
 Experience building high-performance, highly-available and scalable distributed systems 
 Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers 
 Aggressive Refactoring 
 Delivery Technical and Operational excellence 
 Experience with mobile development using the technologies as mentioned below 
 Experience with TDD, Agile, Paired Programming 
 The ability to prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and consistently deliver results 
 Keen attention to detail and high level of commitment. 
 Key areas of focus include: 
 Core Commerce 
 Product Information 
 Connecting the Channels 
 Ease Complex Shopping 
 Service + Care 
 Technology 
 Eclipse 
 Android Studio 
 Java 
 Third Party Libraries 
 Zxing 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
